Prepare Files and Update are separate from Run All. Refresh source files outside Eng and save to EP/temp. Prepare Files copies only missing targets and keeps existing files.
Update uses local PIP history in configs/prepare_history, separated by episode and source folder: completed sources are skipped even if their temp files were deleted; new sources or changed size/modification time are copied. History is saved after each successful copy.

Tạo EP không copy nguyên video nguồn: đọ: Create EP never copies source videos: it reads duration and generates placeholders, including when renaming an existing local file. Cycle building, timing and M3U export do not copy videos. Prepare Files / Update are separate source-drive operations.
Tên ADS đã được người dùng xác nhận lưu: User-confirmed ADS names are stored in approved_ads.json and shared across episodes. User edits in ADS Catalog retain priority. Match confirmed names only; do not guess similar names. Bundled media are duration-matched placeholders.
Canh cuối ngày: giữ ADS ưu tiên, DO_NOT_: End of day: retain priority, DO_NOT_SKIP and rule ADS in retained shows. Move ADS under two minutes from show boundaries to internal gaps in the same cycle; keep M intros and profile placements pinned. If needed, remove ordinary boundary ADS to make room for at most one confirmed, permitted long ADS from INPUT_4. MT adjustments must retain required segment inserts.
SMTV INTRO không bắt buộc: được bỏ sau M: SMTV INTRO is optional and may be removed after MT to fit the day. First try Max/No Max, complete shows, short-ADS relocation, ordinary ADS removal and at most one suitable filler. Only if the ending still misses the 15-second window, try removing post-MT M intro Long/Short and reconsider the next complete show, preferring the fewest intro removals. Never remove pre-MT intros. Report every removed intro.
Khi nhiều file ra cùng tên local, giữ ph: When sources share a local filename, keep the highest version; for equal versions keep the newest modified source. Older-source filtering uses an internal flag independent of UI language. If still ambiguous, the warning lists each duplicate local name and its source files.
QC cuối ngày hiển thị show kế tiếp theo: End-of-day QC shows the next show in the untrimmed cycle order and the total duration of its parts (including IN/MAIN/OUT when present; excluding inserted ADS and M intros). If the built cycles contain no next show, report that no data is available rather than guessing its duration.

Run all kiểm tra trước khi tạo EP: hỏi c: Before creating an EP, Run all checks missing files, including ordinary ADS. Select each item and Browse. For S1B, choose P1A or its folder to review and confirm the complete matching EP/event set, without mixing another reair. S1B/teaser selections are saved per EP. External ADS become duration-matched local temps; confirmed name links are reused across episodes. Recheck validates and continues; you can stop or continue with unresolved issues. After scheduling, QC errors appear for review and rerun. Timing issues require reviewing QC, not choosing arbitrary media.
Tên ADS đã được người dùng xác nhận lưu: Confirmed ADS names are saved in approved_ads.json and reused across episodes. The latest Browse choice overrides the mapping for that exact ADS name; other names still use ADS Catalog. No fuzzy matching. Imported media are duration-matched temps.
Daily News Scroll trong INPUT là DN của: Daily News Scroll in INPUT refers to the NWN daily scroll, not a separate ADS file. DN TEMP is still recognized as NWN Daily Scroll. The missing-file dialog does not ask for this ADS label again; NWN QC still reports a genuinely missing Daily Scroll.
Trong cửa sổ file thiếu, khi bật FN luôn: In the missing-file dialog, FN mode always shows the S1B row so its set can be replaced even when found. Each file has its own Browse button; S1B also has Folder. Status is red for missing files or failed selections and turns green after validation and saving. Recognized ADS are not requested again. When nothing is missing and there are no errors, Run all continues without this dialog.
Cửa sổ chỉ hiển thị mục thiếu hoặc lỗi;: Only missing items or errors are shown; an available S1B set is hidden. Each missing item has Browse and turns green after a successful selection. ADS matching ignores case, separators, duration labels, NEW/AD prefixes and v1/v2 suffixes only when one file matches. Content and numbers are preserved; ambiguous matches require selection. Abbreviated titles use confirmed aliases rather than guesses.
SMTV INTRO là ADS thường: chỉ được đứng: SMTV INTRO is ordinary ADS: it stays at cycle start only if retained and must not displace priority ADS at the previous cycle end. Slot allocation retains profile/rule ADS and DO_NOT_SKIP, then PRIORITY, then teasers/ordinary ADS; discarded INTRO is never moved inside a show. MT alignment tries Max/No Max and adding/moving/removing ordinary ADS, including SMTV INTRO, across nearby then earlier cycles first. Only after all priority-preserving attempts fail the 15-second tolerance may unlocked PRIORITY be removed. QC records removed INTRO and ADS. One item per gap and long ADS between shows remain enforced.
Nối NWN cuối ngày chỉ đến S3: Forced NWN extension ends at S3
Khi dùng ngoại lệ nối thêm show kế tiếp: When the final fallback appends the next show and it is NWN, include program content S1A, the S1B set, S1C, S2 and S3 only. Do not append teasers, Daily Scroll or trailing ADS. Missing S3 is an error; never append an incomplete set. This applies only to the forced final extension; ordinary NWN blocks retain their existing timing rules.
Khi thiếu giờ tới mốc cuối ngày: ưu tiên: When short of the end-day target, prefer available Max variants, then move long ADS from the discarded end of the same cycle to replace shorter between-show ADS, then add/replace one INPUT_4 ADS at one position. If still short, try pulling the next show forward, restarting from the original schedule so previous filler is not retained. Removal preference: ordinary ADS including SMTV INTRO; FN/NWN internal inserts; M intro Long/Short; priority/DO_NOT_SKIP ADS; finally at most one post-MT Daily Scroll. These are preferences: combine Max, removals and replacements to fit. Preserve one insert under two minutes between show segments and all pre-MT content. Appended NWN ends at S3 without teasers, DN or trailing ADS. If no retained candidate fits within 15 seconds, allow overrun with a QC warning. Search limits are disclosed; no claim that every combination was exhausted.
Teaser FN nguồn thay temp cũ: Source FN teaser replaces older temps
Khi nguồn EP có teaser FN thật, dùng các: When the EP source contains real FN teasers, use those scanned source teasers and exclude previous manual/temp FN names from the schedule. Never treat an excluded FN temp as a SHOW teaser. Multiple real source FN teasers still require selection. FN Browse accepts TSER/TEASER FN files, not S1B program parts.
All cycles: Length là thời lượng riêng c: All cycles: Length is the duration of each item; End is cumulative time from the beginning of the playlist through that item, without resetting at cycle boundaries.
MT shift (shows) chọn từ -5 đến +5 và nh: MT shift (shows) ranges from -5 to +5 and remembers the last selection. Zero keeps the normal automatic placement. Negative values select an earlier show boundary; positive values a later one relative to the normal result for the same inputs. Count program blocks, not segments or ADS. Refit Max/ADS and day end at that boundary; the MT clock target stays unchanged. If the 15-second tolerance cannot be met, report QC instead of silently choosing another show. Positions outside the available shows are rejected.
Update PIP kiểm tra và tải các file chươ: Update PIP checks and downloads changed program files. INPUT.xlsx is replaced only when selected and is backed up first. Scheduler closes, applies the update and restarts. Installation errors trigger rollback and an error message. ADS, EP files, playlists, settings and recognition history are kept. Installations without this button need the new portable package once.
